settings.title: Grow lights for plant shelves.
settings.content: Shelf setups need light coverage that works across rows, layers, and multiple small pots.

settings.title: The shelf problem
settings.content: Plants on shelves can shade each other, and lower shelves often receive less natural light.

settings.title: Recommended setup
settings.content: Use clip-on or panel-style grow lights that can aim across a shelf row without crowding the plants.

settings.title: Soliseed shelf grow light
settings.content: A compact option for racks, shelves, and nursery tray areas.

settings.title: Setup tips
settings.content: Check each shelf level separately. Adjust light angle and distance when plants are moved or grouped differently.

settings.title: Do all shelf plants need the same light position?
settings.content: No. Shelf height, plant size, and distance from windows can all change the best placement.

settings.title: Light the shelf, not just one pot.
settings.content: Help users think in rows, layers, and reachable adjustment points.
